observedConfiguration.action: do not mutate or roll back; re-freeze only after operator attribution and explicit approval

protocol.cold: Obsidian fully terminated; frozen configuration and iCloud/index state recorded before launch; no mixing with warm samples
protocol.warm: Obsidian process resident; target closed and reopened under the same frozen configuration; no mixing with cold samples
protocol.externalStream: User/device stopwatch or screen-recording frame delta carries correlation_id and is reported beside, never subtracted from, performance.now phases
protocol.receiptExport: Explicit redacted preview then user-confirmed external save under final SHA/run ID; no Vault telemetry write
protocol.settings: One explicitly approved variable per comparison, byte-exact external backup/read-back before mutation, rollback hash equality, no tab/plugin deletion or reorder

physicalEvidence.required: User-attributable iPhone/iPad Obsidian Mobile receipt bound to implementationFinalGitSha and frozenConfiguration.sha256

openGates: Reconcile the observed workspace-mobile configuration drift before freezing a final campaign configuration.
Capture the operator-approved external backup and exact settings comparison, or record a rejected candidate with rollback proof.
Run the physical cold/warm campaign with at least 20 valid samples per class and export validated receipts.
Run final cross-workspace physical journey/device evidence; do not claim success from the synthetic or desktop harness campaign.
